methods.formula: Value = (assets in place + C − net debt) ÷ shares;  C = S·N(d₁) − K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂), d₁ = [ln(S ÷ K) + (r + σ²/2)T] ÷ σ√T, d₂ = d₁ − σ√T
steps: S = the expansion in year 5: the revenue it adds $4.50B (to $9.62B) × margin 15.5% × (1 − tax), as a growing perpetuity, discounted = $2.90B

σ = 49% (its stock, a year of daily closes), T = 5 years, r = 4.91% → C = $466.5M
